brief: The canvas displays a side-scrolling environment featuring ground platforms and vertical gaps. A player character is central to the scene, and the user controls this character using keyboard or mouse input to run left, run right, and jump. Another visible enemy sprite patrols the ground, moving rhythmically back and forth along defined pathways. The player must navigate this space, jumping over gaps and coordinating movement to avoid the enemy while progressing through the level. Both the enemy's patrolling movement and the player's controlled actions dictate the flow and state of the game.

The visual design uses simple shapes and colors to represent game elements, with motion and interaction driving the experience.
